caption: A woman with long dark hair and round glasses, in a green-and-white polo shirt, sits at a table before a red brick wall crossed by a green pipe. A tall glass of water stands near the table's center, flanked by small white cards and a black-and-white illusion print at the left. She holds a black marker in her right hand, its tip positioned just above the rim of the glass, where a refracted image of her fingers shows through the water. She draws the marker back and up to her right side, holding it at an angle while her gaze drops toward the tabletop. After a moment she lowers the marker toward a white card lying beside the glass. From the middle of the clip she presses the tip to the card and writes, head tilted down, torso leaning slightly forward. The marker moves in small strokes across the paper as she continues this writing motion. The glass, cards, illusion print, and brick background remain fixed throughout.
